MVP-Y1.title: Aven response rule
MVP-Y1.text: Aven-61 response rule: when flux relay bounce is confirmed, isolate the auxiliary bus and run L3 latch reset.

capsule.claim: For confirmed flux relay bounce, isolate the auxiliary bus and run L3 latch reset.
capsule.conditions: Flux relay bounce is confirmed on Aven-61.
capsule.limitations: Does not diagnose the signal by itself.

MVP-Y1.title: Elio evidence rule
MVP-Y1.text: Elio-65 evidence rule: while bearing resonance and mounting echo remain unresolved, do not choose a repair; first collect a vibration trace.

capsule.claim: Do not choose a repair yet; first collect a vibration trace.
capsule.conditions: The cause remains unresolved between bearing resonance and mounting echo.
capsule.limitations: Does not choose between the two causes.
